Smooth move for a reasonable price

I had a very smooth move from Tilburg to Fontainebleau (FR) with de bresser. Pricing was reasonable for a small move with just boxes and suitcases. The staff were very friendly and professional. They arrived on time for both loading and unloading. Reliable movers, highly recommend!

Would be good to agree on the loading time a bit sooner than the day before the move but I understand if this is a planning constraint. Once communicated, the loading was done as planned so very good. Also, maybe good to provide the number of the driver who is helping with loading/unloading for direct communication just in case there is any delay or urgent questions. But overall, all went smoothly. Thank you!
